summary: Hand-built internal/appstore client for Apple's public App Store surfaces (iTunes Lookup and Search APIs, legacy RSS charts and customer reviews, search hints plist, server-rendered apps.apple.com product/chart/developer/Today/see-all pages, opt-in web search and /api), the App Store snapshot schema and typed store accessors, the --country/--lang root flags, and the shared CLI helpers the hand-built commands use.
reason: The spec declares only the generated 'categories' endpoints; every App Store command reads several hosts with different pacing (Search API ~20/min), parses Apple's serialized-server-data page models and RSS/plist bodies the generator's typed-endpoint path cannot model, and records time-series snapshots with provenance (capture log). The client paces per host with cliutil.AdaptiveLimiter, stops the run at the first 403/429 (*cliutil.RateLimitError, exit 7), retries a 5xx once, honours Cache-Control with a file cache, follows redirects only within Apple's hosts and refuses robots-disallowed surfaces unless a command opts in explicitly.
call_sites: opts := appstore.Options{Country: cc, StatePath: appStoreGovernorPath(), WaitUntil: harnessWaitUntil()}
validated_outcome: go build, go vet and go test -count=1 ./... green; fixture tests cover every parser (product, charts, developer, Today, see-all, lookup/search, RSS charts, reviews RSS, hints plist, opt-in /api samples); httptest covers governor (403/429 stop, no retry), 5xx single retry, 404 typing, Chrome UA, cache honour/bypass, per-host pacing classes and redirects. Live acceptance on 2026-10-23 (5 sequential requests, all HTTP 200): Lookup 324684580 us, chart page us/iphone/36 (25 lockups + 175 ids per segment), Spotify product page (histogram sums to totalRatings within 0.001%), reviews RSS 6448311069 page 1 mostrecent (50 entries), hints 'insta' (10 suggestions). Review fixes on 2026-10-24 (parser generation appstore-parsers/2): a result is verified-empty only inside the documented envelope (Lookup/Search, RSS, hints, /api), pages are logged and cached after their typed parse with the parsed row count, every robots-disallowed apps.apple.com path (and redirect hop) needs the explicit opt-in, the cache keeps nothing longer than 15 minutes and every result carries FetchedAt/FromCache, and chart snapshots carry an age_band key (Kids charts are their own series). A sweep of 50 non-empty raw captures found no false failure and no cross-surface verified-empty; live check (3 sequential requests, all HTTP 200): Lookup id 1, reviews RSS id 1 and hints for a nonsense term all come back verified-empty. Post-merge integration fixes on 2026-10-24 (zero live requests): chart snapshots are written as genre + age_band and read back by movers/rank-history/breakouts --age-band; every snapshot writer is idempotent on the observation and stamps FetchedAt (app_snapshots.source column); FetchMeta carries Age/max-age/DataAsOf (ratings_snapshots.data_as_of); Lookup keeps completed batches on a later batch failure; jitter is a per-request send slot after the limiter; 404 is not-found only for id-addressed resources; --lang adds l= to page URLs; empty IAP lists and privacy labels the page positively shows are change points; /api review upserts keep votes; store.AppIDForBundle and store.AppsWithHistory back bundle ids in local commands; the --home override is scoped to its invocation (root.go: Execute defers executeHomeScope, PersistentPreRunE wraps SetHomeOverride in scopeHomeOverride). Live-acceptance fixes on 2026-10-24: the governor keeps its memory across invocations in <state dir>/appstore-governor.json (file-locked): per-class send slots (a new process paces from the previous process's last request), a per-host hold after a 403/429 of max(Retry-After, 5 min) that refuses later requests to that host without sending (exit 7), uncached apps.apple.com pages paced one per 20 s (+0-20% jitter), --rate-limit also caps the combined rate across classes and processes, a send slot past the --timeout deadline fails fast without sending, and pacing waits of 3 s or more are announced on stderr. A page+lookup snapshot takes its version, release date and notes from appstore.CurrentVersion (the product page's newest entry when the page's data is newer than a Lookup CDN copy naming another version; versionSource/lookupVersion record it) and the page ratings row pairs the page's totals with the page's own newest version. categories list and categories games answer from the built-in genre table (no request; a registerNovelCommand hook swaps them in for the generated pair, whose generated client retried 429s outside the governor), and a registerClientHook puts every generated-client request to an App Store host (the MCP server's typed categories tools) under the same governor state: shared send slots, refusal during a hold, holds recorded from its 403/429s with Retry-After rewritten so the generated retry loop stops at once. Live re-run of the throttle-stopped acceptance checks on 2026-10-23T22:45-22:46Z through the fixed binary (--home .acceptance-home, --rate-limit 0.33): 9 sequential requests, all HTTP 200, no throttle, at least 3 s between any two and 20-23 s between page fetches, with the governor's wait notes on stderr: categories list (0 requests, 6014 and 6026 listed), suggest insta (10 suggestions), keyword-rank spotify --app 324684580 (rank 1 of 177), search-store spotify --limit 10 (Spotify first), reviews 6448311069 --source api --pages 1 (the one /api call, 20 rows), app 553834731 --full (10 IAP rows priced in $; version 1.339.0.2 agrees across the JSON, the snapshot and the page ratings row; a 4h45m-old Lookup copy is noted), featured (32 stories), and a second top capture after which movers reports 70 climbed, 96 dropped, 2 entered and 2 exited.
